prompt.text: Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of STEED FOAL. Redraw the referenced subject as the sheet described below. The frames in order: tail coiled, tail uncoiling mid-thrust, fins braced with static ticks, a banking lean, a nose-down stoop, a level glide. Follow the established design exactly; only the pose or state changes between cells. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
